C1217.title: PoisonedFL: Multi-Round Consistency Model Poisoning Attack in Federated Learning
C1217.summary: This study introduces PoisonedFL, a novel model poisoning attack that forces malicious clients to maintain multi-round consistency in model updates, successfully breaching eight state-of-the-art defense mechanisms and outperforming seven existing attack methods.
